segments.ja460:1.3: Pabbajissāmahaṃ rāja [pabbajissaṃ mahārāja (sī. pī.)], taṃ devo anumaññatu.
segments.ja460:2.1: Sace te ūnaṃ kāmehi, ahaṃ paripūrayāmi [ahaṃva pūrayāmi (ka.)] te;
segments.ja460:2.3: Yo taṃ hiṃsati vāremi, mā pabbaja [pabbaji (pī.)] yudhañcaya [yudhañjaya (sī. syā.), yuvañjaya (pī.)].
segments.ja460:3.1: Na matthi ūnaṃ kāmehi, hiṃsitā me na vijjati;
segments.ja460:4.1: Putto vā pitaraṃ yāce, pitā vā puttamorasaṃ;
segments.ja460:4.3: Negamo taṃ yāce [negamo yācate (sī. syā. pī.)] tāta, mā pabbaja yudhañcaya.
segments.ja460:5.1: Mā maṃ deva nivārehi, pabbajantaṃ rathesabha;
segments.ja460:6.1: Ahaṃ taṃ tāta yācāmi, ahaṃ putta nivāraye;
segments.ja460:6.3: Ciraṃ taṃ daṭṭhumicchāmi, mā pabbaja yudhañcaya.
segments.ja460:7.3: Evamāyu manussānaṃ, mā maṃ amma nivāraya.
segments.ja460:8.1: Taramāno imaṃ yānaṃ, āropetu [taramānā imaṃ yānaṃ, āropentu (sī. pī.)] rathesabha;
segments.ja460:8.3: Mā me mātā tarantassa, antarāyakarā ahu.
segments.ja460:10.1: Yohu seṭṭho sahassassa [manussānaṃ (syā.), sahassānaṃ (ka.)], yuvā kañcanasannibho;
